annotations.title: Work out the salary for a take-home figure

description: Work out the gross UK salary needed to take home a given amount a year after income tax, employee National Insurance, student loan and a pension percentage, for a tax year (net to gross).

pensionPercent.description: Employee pension as a percentage of gross, e.g. 5

scottishTaxpayer.description: True for a Scottish taxpayer (Scottish bands)

studentLoanPlan.description: Student loan plans held: one plan or a list of every plan, e.g. ["plan2", "postgrad"]. plan1 (pre-2012), plan2 (2012 onwards), plan4 (Scotland), plan5 (2023 onwards), postgrad (postgraduate loan, repaid alongside any other plan). Omit or "none" for no loan.

targetTakeHome.description: Take-home pay wanted a year, in pounds

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.

name: calculate_gross_salary_for_take_home
title: Work out the salary for a take-home figure
